Getting Started

Welcome to the getting started guide. This will walk you through the basics of setting up our platform.

Installation

First, install the package using npm:

npm install our-package

Then import it in your project:

import { setup } from 'our-package';

Configuration

Create a config file at the root of your project:

  • Set the apiKey to your API key
  • Set the environment to production or development
OptionDefaultDescription
apiKeynoneYour API key
environmentdevelopmentTarget environment
timeout5000Request timeout in ms

Next Steps

Check out the API Reference for complete documentation.
